additive_amount: below stoichiometric equivalence with H2BDC (range spanning >4 orders of magnitude)
morphology_as_written: Crystal morphology is largely unaffected by the use of PAA modulator at low concentrations ... highly faceted or regular geometries were not obtained
mechanism_as_written: A polyacid chain carries many acid groups, so its local acid concentration is far above the bulk value; 3 eq. of PAA already over-modulates (non-crystalline solid), against more than 300 eq. for acetic acid.
notes: Solvent and temperature are in the ESI, not the main text. Acetic acid comparison: only about 30 eq. gave particles below 300 nm; more than 30 eq. gave larger, broader sizes; more than 300 eq. gave no solid. Shapes for the acetic acid samples are not described in the text, so they are not entered as records.
